name: XIS
summary: Queensland ISP (XiS Pty Ltd, ABN 59 098 079 782, formerly X Corp Online); Brisbane (Carindale) dial-up/ADSL/hosting with a Brisbane call centre; acquired Deltaweb 2001; sold its WA ADSL customer base to Fleet Broadband 2002; liquidated ~2003.

events.details: X Corp Online Pty Ltd (brand XiS from 2001).

Failed national ADSL rollout (2001-02) drew TIO complaints and pre-paid refund issues; XiS sold its Western Australian ADSL customer base to Fleet Broadband (confirmed by Fleet, 1 Aug 2002). A full Fleet takeover was considered but did not proceed.
